summary: This is a Quarto presentation file that uses reveal.js to create an interactive slideshow. The YAML header at the top configures the presentation settings, specifically telling it to use vertical navigation mode so viewers can scroll up and down through slides. The rest of the file outlines the slide structure with a main title and several nested subsections.

explanations.3: The 'format' key tells Quarto what kind of output to create — in this case a reveal.js presentation (a popular JavaScript framework for making slideshows).
explanations.5: Setting 'navigation-mode' to 'vertical' means the slide navigation will work top-to-bottom, so Slide 1.1 appears below Slide 1 rather than to the side.
